sentences.text:
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 Cr.P.C. apprehending
his arrest in F.I.R./Crime No. Rc 03(A)/2022, Police Station Cbi/Scb, Lucknow under Section
120B r/w 406 and 420 Ipc & Section 7 of Pc Act, 1988 & Section 13(2) r/w 13(1)(d) Pc Act, 1988.
Counter affidavit filed by Shri Anurag Singh learned counsel for Cbi is taken on record.

Heard Shri Pranjal Krishna, learned counsel for the applicant as well as Shri Anurag Kumar Singh,
learned counsel for CBI.

This Court while granting interim protection to the applicant vide order dated 07.08.2024 has passed the following order:-
"The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Crime No. RC 03(A)/2022, P.S. CBI/SCB Lucknow, Lucknow.
Shri Datt Sharma vs Cbi/Scb Lko on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63849517/
1
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as Shri Anurag Kumar, learned counsel for CBI.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

In the charge sheet para 16.30, it is alleged that Shri Dutt Sharma (then Cluster Head AGM and Shri Arvind Kumar (then Chief Manager) did not monitor and use of funds which were diverted in lending unsecured loans to private parties for which credit facility was not sanctioned.

It is also alleged that pursuant to the criminal conspiracy,
both have allowed non-business transactions to the accused company M/s Atarson Overseas Pvt. Ltd. which caused wrongful loss to the bank.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he is not the person responsible to monitor end use of funds.
In support of the contention, he has drawn attention of the Court towards the document on record Annexure No. 9 and 10.
It has been further submitted that the applicant has retired as Chief Manager on 31.03.2023.
The custody of the applicant was not sought by the CBI.
It is also submitted that since charge sheet has been filed, therefore, no custodial interrogation is required.
The applicant cooperated in the investigation.

In support of his contention, learned counsel for the applicant has relied on the judgments of the Supreme Court passed in the cases of "Satendra Kumar Antil Vs.
CBI and others, SLP Criminal No. 5191/2021", "Mahdoom Bava Vs. CBI, SLP (Crl No.
376/2023", "Aman Preet Singh Vs. CBI, Criminal Appeal No. 929/20211" and "Siddharth Vs. State of U.P. and another", (2022) 1 SCC 676".
Learned counsel for the applicant undertakes that the applicant shall cooperate in the trial.
Shri Anurag Kumar Singh, learned counsel for CBI does not dispute the fact that during investigation, the applicant was not taken into custody and at present also custody is not required.
Learned counsel appearing for CBI prays for and is allowed ten days' time to file counter affidavit.
List on 28.08.2024.

Till the next date of listing, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of Shri Datt Sharma vs Cbi/Scb Lko on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63849517/

The applicant has cooperated in the investigation and further undertakes to cooperate in the trial.
Learned counsel for CBI has vehemently opposed the bail application.

On due consideration to the judgment of the Supreme Court passed in the case of "Mahdoom Bava v. CBI, 2023 SCC OnLine SC 299" as well as considering the fact that charge sheet has been filed in the matter; the applicant has cooperated in the investigation and further undertakes to cooperate in the trial, the interim protection granted vide order dated 07.08.2024 is made absolute in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
